summary: Offline English speech-to-text with Phonon-2 from Fermion Research: a 164 MB model that runs on the CPU. The model downloads once, on first use, and is checked against a pinned sha256.
author: Subtitld
license: Apache-2.0 (add-on and engine); Phonon-2 weights CC-BY-4.0

fields.label: Models folder
fields.help: Leave empty to share Subtitld's model cache. To use another folder, type its path, or browse to any file inside it.

fields.label: CPU threads
fields.help: 0 = auto. Applies when the model loads.

fields.label: Hotwords
fields.help: Names and terms to favour, separated by commas (up to 25). The audio still decides.
